BUILDING & EXTENSIONS
Extend Your Living Space
Without The Trouble Of
Moving House

Not only can extensions add value to your home. Home extensions can be a great way to increase the amount of space in your home by providing extra floors, adding rooms, and making the most of any existing outdoor space.

Homeowners looking to expand might opt for additional living spaces such as sunrooms or conservatories, as they maximise direct sunlight while providing spectacular views and airy living areas.

Home extensions also offer a chance to tailor designs and materials to individual tastes, with modern builds often benefitting from incorporation of smart technology and energy-efficient solutions.

KITCHEN & BATHROOM
Inject Style, Creativity,
Practicality And Freshness Into
Your Kitchen Or Bathroom

Kitchen and Bathroom renovations are one of the best ways to give your home a complete facelift. Homeowners who want to make sure they get the highest return on their investment should consider giving their Kitchen and Bathroom spaces a refresh when possible.

Not only do Kitchen and Bathroom renovations add aesthetic appeal and modern touches, but they can also improve functionality. Whether you’re thinking of adding additional counter space or making room for a luxurious whirlpool bath, Kitchen and Bathroom renovations transform your living space into an unforgettable retreat. With careful planning, quality materials, and an eye for detail, Smith Joinery can truly create something special.

JOINERY
The Art Of Putting Pieces Together

Providing a high-quality solution for any project, we work with various materials such as wood, metal, and plastic to construct the best possible structure to complete a space and help bring your vision to life.

We offer the perfect solution for anyone looking to improve their home or office with quality products and professional and safe installation.

CARPENTRY
Carpentry is a skill that requires precision and creativity, as well as a good eye for detail.

We work with many different materials, from softwoods to hardwoods, to create a vast array of furniture and structures within your home.

We take the time to make sure the highest quality standards are met.
